subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 26, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - August 26, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

We're excited to share the latest updates from the AcreetionOS project. As we continue to work towards making our distribution the go-to choice for those seeking a secure and user-friendly Linux experience, we've made significant progress in the past week.

Our flagship release, AcreetionOS 1.0 - Cinnamon X11, has been officially released. This version boasts a sleek and intuitive interface, perfect for those who value simplicity and ease of use. Additionally, we've also released AcreetionOS 1.0 - Cinnamon XL (XLibre), catering to users who prefer a more lightweight experience.

In the community, we've seen some exciting developments. Our team has been working tirelessly to ensure that our codebase remains up-to-date and secure. We've also made significant contributions to the Linux community, including the release of mklinux-v7.0-mk2, which allows users to experiment with the multi-kernel Linux concept.

Vanilla OS 3, an immutable desktop Linux distribution, has also been released. This is an interesting development in the world of Linux, and we're excited to see how it will shape the future of our ecosystem.

On the security front, we've been keeping a close eye on the latest updates and patches. Our team has been working diligently to ensure that our distribution remains secure and up-to-date.

In other news, our wiki guides have been updated to reflect the latest changes in the Arch Linux community. We've also made significant improvements to our CI/CD pipeline, including the addition of bidirectional mirror workflows.

We're proud to announce that our community has been growing steadily, with new members joining our Discord server and contributing to our codebase. We're grateful for the enthusiasm and dedication of our community members, and we look forward to seeing what the future holds.

As we continue to work towards our goals, we're committed to transparency and open communication. We'll be sharing regular updates on our progress, and we encourage our community members to participate in the discussion and provide feedback.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds, and we're grateful for your support.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
